# RAIMOV Whole-Person Study Club

**Status:** `OWNER_APPROVED_DIRECTION / NOT_LAUNCHED`
**Authority:** `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_WHOLE_PERSON_BRAND.md` + `DEC-864`

The Study Club is the approved professional community around evidence-aware Whole-Person Dentistry: structured case review, clinical reasoning, interdisciplinary planning, sequencing, trade-offs, scope boundaries, referral decisions and follow-up.

Before public launch it requires an explicit audience and format, a clinical owner/reviewer, sufficient teachable cases with consent and de-identification, medical/privacy/legal review, an approved offer and professional data flow, and separate analytics/release evidence.

It is not accreditation, certification, a launched Academy or proof that a proprietary methodology is validated.
